hub.lead: Interactive views tied to quantitative projects — delayed data, educational use.

implied-vol.title: Implied volatility (SPY)
implied-vol.description: IV surface, smile and term structure from a Yahoo Finance snapshot.

overview.surfaceHint: 2D preview — open Surface tab for 3D view

surface.title: Implied vol surface
surface.mobileFallback: 3D view hidden on small screens — use the heatmap below.

chain.title: Options chain · {symbol} · {expiry} ({days}d)
chain.empty: No IV points for this expiry.

disclaimer.title: Disclaimer
disclaimer.body: Educational demo only. Yahoo Finance delayed data (~15 min). Not investment advice.

about.methodologyBody: Options chain via yfinance, SVI/SSVI calibration (ivsurface package), offline JSON export served by the Next.js API. Refresh reloads the cached snapshot.
about.pipelineSteps: Yahoo Finance (yfinance) → options chain → SSVI calibration (ivsurface) → JSON export → Next.js API → React dashboard.

tooltips.expiry: Selects the expiry shown on the smile chart and options chain.
tooltips.refresh: Reloads the snapshot from server cache (no live Yahoo stream in the browser).
tooltips.ssvi: SSVI curve fitted on the slice — dashed model overlay.
tooltips.termStructure: ATM IV (moneyness ≈ 1) vs days to expiry.
tooltips.heatmap: IV map: moneyness (horizontal) × days to expiry (vertical). Color = IV level.
tooltips.surface3d: 3D IV surface: auto-rotation around the vertical axis. Top-right button toggles it. Click a point (when rotation is off) to select an expiry.
tooltips.chain: Strike and IV grid for the selected expiry (Yahoo snapshot data).
tooltips.overviewStats: Key snapshot metrics: symbol, spot, expiry count and ATM IV range.
tooltips.skew25d: Skew proxy: IV difference between ~0.9 moneyness (puts) and ~1.1 (calls), in percentage points.
